name: Pharmaceutical & Biotech
description:
Karnataka, India's biotechnology hub, houses a large number of
                                biotech firms, research institutions, and startups. Major players like Biocon, Strides
                                Pharma, Aurobindo Pharma, Novartis, AstraZeneca, and Merck have a strong presence in the
                                state. The government actively supports research and development in this sector.

name: Electrical Machinery & Equipment
description:
Karnataka's electrical equipment and machinery industry is a vital
                                part of the state's industrial landscape. It produces a wide array of products including
                                power transmission equipment, electrical machinery, appliances, components, lighting,
                                and renewable energy equipment. Major companies like ABB India, Siemens, Schneider
                                Electric, Havells, and BHEL have a strong presence in the state.

name: Ready-made garments
description:
Karnataka boasts a rich textile manufacturing tradition, notably in
                                Bengaluru, Mysuru, Hubballi-Dharwad, and Belagavi. Handloom weaving and textile
                                production are deeply ingrained in the state's culture and economy. Key segments include
                                cotton, silk, wool, technical textiles, and garment manufacturing. The state's vibrant
                                handloom sector thrives in clusters like Ilkal, Banahatti, and Gadag, producing unique
                                textiles using traditional techniques.

name: Automobile
description:
Karnataka is a major automobile manufacturing hub in India, home to
                                prominent manufacturers like Toyota Kirloskar Motor, Tata Motors, and Mahindra &
                                Mahindra. The state is emerging as an electric vehicle hub with companies focused on
                                manufacturing and R&D.

name: Organic Chemicals
description:
Karnataka's diverse chemicals industry encompasses petrochemicals,
                                specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and industrial chemicals. The state
                                hosts petrochemical facilities producing essential raw materials for various downstream
                                products. Specialty chemicals used in textiles, paints, coatings, adhesives, and
                                cosmetics are also a significant sector. The government supports the industry through
                                investment incentives, infrastructure development, skill programs, and R&D support.

name: Aerospace
description:
Karnataka has a growing aerospace sector, particularly in
                                Bengaluru, with companies manufacturing components, assemblies and systems for aircraft
                                and helicopters. The government supports this growth through infrastructure, investment
                                incentives and industry and research institution collaborations.

name: Optical and Medical
description:
Renowned as the "Silicon Valley of India," Bengaluru isn't just a
                                tech hub – it's also a thriving center for chemical research and development. 
                                Karnataka's increasing emphasis on high-value specialty chemicals is further bolstering
                                sectors like automotive, electronics, and personal care. The presence of the Mangalore
                                SEZ, with its focus on petrochemicals, chemicals, and related industries, provides the
                                essential infrastructure to support large-scale operations.

name: Food Products
description:
Karnataka's diverse food industry spans agriculture, processing,
                                packaged foods, and beverages. The state's varied climate and fertile land yield a wide
                                array of crops like rice, sugarcane, coffee, spices, fruits, vegetables, and pulses.
                                Numerous processing units statewide like sugar mills, coffee curing, rice mills and
                                processing units add value to this produce. The government supports the industry through
                                incentives, infrastructure, and skill development programs.
